lines.t: [Dark upright piano, deliberate and solemn]
[Solo cello enters quietly with a low, breathing arc]
[Verse 1]
In the silent hours, I trace the scars across my frame
Counting every breath against the aching and the shame
It’s so easy to forget how near You choose to draw
When the body feels like dust, bound to nature’s heavy law
But You breathe upon the ashes… You sit beside the bed
And softly cradle every prayer I’ve left unsaid
[Pre-Chorus]
[Cello swells, adding a mournful, beautiful counter-melody]
I can feel the chill retreating, feel the turning of the tide
There’s a joy that’s starting right down deep inside…
[Verse 2 - Spoken Rap]
Listen to me…
This ache is just a temporary room.
It’s not where we end.
I’m looking past the fracture, past the fading skin
To the day YahuShua steps into the room and lets the forever begin.
No more tears, no more limping through the dark,
No more carrying the weight of a shattered, fragile heart.
He takes my face in His hands—those hands that bled—
Wipes away the heavy drops where the grief was shed.
Laughter… actual laughter, bubbling up inside,
Where the pain used to hide.
[Chorus]
So be at peace, my soul, the promised morning’s near!
Laughter takes the place of every ancient, hidden tear!
I will look upon His face, held tight within His grace
In the arms of YahuShua, in that holy, healing place!
[Bridge]
Death is swallowed up in life, the shadow falls away!
No more groaning in the night, no more waiting for the day!
Perfect praise is rising, unhindered and complete
As the Kingdom meets the earth right beneath our feet!
[Chorus]
Be at peace, my soul, the promised morning’s near!
Laughter takes the place of every ancient, hidden tear!
I will look upon His face, held tight within His grace
In the arms of YahuShua, in that holy, healing place!
[Outro]
[Soft piano chords slowing down]
[Cello holds a single, warm, comforting low note]
No more pain…
Only laughter in the morning.
Safe in YahuShua’s arms.
Be at peace.
[Fade to complete silence]
